purpose: Govern merged state-vendor and federal-award classification for ORION prospect segmentation.

federalTruth.zeroSalesRule: Only classify zero federal sales after authoritative identity reconciliation and zero matching prime awards plus zero matching subcontract awards.

segments.FED_ONLY: Confirmed federal prime and/or subcontract history with no confirmed SLED award history.
segments.SLED_ONLY: Confirmed SLED prime award history and authoritative zero federal prime/subcontract history.
segments.FED_AND_SLED: Confirmed federal prime/subcontract history and confirmed SLED award history.
segments.STATE_VENDOR_ONLY: Appears on one or more state vendor lists but has no confirmed state award history and authoritative zero federal history.
segments.ZERO_GOVERNMENT_SALES: No federal or SLED awards after authoritative checks and not merely a state vendor-list registration.
segments.UNCONFIRMED: Identity or federal award truth is not authoritative enough for final market classification.

marketing.messagePremise: The contractor has already demonstrated government performance at the state level; federal is the logical next growth market.
